description: This file defines an abstract generic class 'GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec' implementing a surrogate serializer for value types, supporting serialization and deserialization via surrogate types within the Orleans serialization framework.

classes.name: GeneralizedValueTypeSurrogateCodec
classes.description: An abstract generic class providing surrogate serialization for value types, supporting conversion between the value type and its surrogate.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Reads a value of type TField from the reader, using a surrogate deserialization and conversion.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a value of type TField to the writer, converting it to its surrogate form.

methods.name: ConvertFromSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert from surrogate type to the field type.

methods.name: ConvertToSurrogate
methods.description: Abstract method to convert from the field type to its surrogate type.
